column2: Python is a popular programming language used for web development, AI, data science, and automation.
AI means Artificial Intelligence. It allows machines to think and make decisions like humans.
Machine Learning is a part of AI where computers learn from data.
NLP means Natural Language Processing. It helps computers understand human language.
Streamlit is a Python library used to build web apps easily.
Start with Python, NumPy, Pandas, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and NLP.
Cosine similarity is a technique used to measure how similar two text documents are.
TF-IDF is a method used to convert text into numerical values for machine learning.
